name: Alisos Animal Hospital
description: Alisos Animal Hospital provides veterinary care for dogs in Mission Viejo, CA. Confirm hours and services directly with the clinic.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: This place actually gets a 4 for the vet services and the vet himself. Fabulous with animals and really cutting edge information. Gets on the floor with your dog for exam–couldn’t be a better vet!

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: We love Dr. Bahou. He’s an excellent veterinarian and he loves our pets. I always know they’re getting the best care here at a fair price.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: Great! Dr Bahou is an amazing vet and you can tell he truly cares about animals. He made my skittish dog feel very comfortable when examining her. All the other staff are great too!

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: I love Dr. B. He is very good with my dog. He sits on the floor with her and gets on the same level. He helped so much with her allergies. She also had a dental cleaning and some spots removed. They care a lot about their patients. They disclose pricing up front prior to you booking any surgeries or filling medication. I really appreciate that as there are no surprises.

reviews.author: Pet parent
reviews.text: I’ve been bringing all my animals to Dr Bahou for 15 years now. I trust him and wont go elsewhere! He’s been very helpful and caring and doesnt perform unnecessary tests. He works the best with me on cost, since I have many animals and my income is not the greatest. I recommend him to many people!
